title: Correct force magnitude
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the force must be correctly calculated as approximately 4.8 × 10⁻¹⁴ N.

title: Apply Lorentz force law
description: Important: The response must correctly state or apply the formula F = |q|vB for a charge moving perpendicular to a magnetic field.

title: Identify charge and values
description: Important: The response must correctly identify the electron's charge (q = -1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C or its magnitude) and plug in the given v and B.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The final answer should be presented with the correct SI unit (Newtons, N).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the answer incorrectly includes a negative sign for the force magnitude or confuses direction with magnitude.
